description: isometric pixel art building for a fantasy village builder game, bright vivid saturated colours, crisp dark outlines, a single isolated object on a plain background, part of a stone stronghold at the edge of a forest, made of grey hewn stone, heavy timber and iron, standing directly on bare ground with no ground tile, base or platform under it, the armoury: a sturdy stone hall with a wooden shingle roof and a wide open front, inside wooden stands with suits of armour and racks of swords and spears, each stand with a small wooden name plate, round shields hanging on the stone wall
